parts.when: [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), as an enemy unit picks a **HARLEQUINS** unit of yours as a target.
parts.effect: Whenever a model in the unit is **destroyed**, if the unit has not yet been **selected to fight** in the phase, roll a D6: on a 4+, leave that model on the battlefield until the unit has fought or the phase ends, whichever is first, then remove it.

data.summary:
**When:** [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), as an enemy unit picks a **HARLEQUINS** unit of yours as a target.

**Target:** That **HARLEQUINS** unit.

**Effect:** Whenever a model in the unit is **destroyed**, if the unit has not yet been **selected to fight** in the phase, roll a D6: on a 4+, leave that model on the battlefield until the unit has fought or the phase ends, whichever is first, then remove it.

effect.trigger: a target model is destroyed before its unit is selected to fight
